Class IndividualClient

java.lang.Object
Business.Entities.IndividualClient
All Implemented Interfaces:
Customer
public class IndividualClient extends Object implements Customer
Represents an individual (retail) client who shops in person at the store. Implements the Customer interface and provides a pricing strategy based on customer loyalty (number of registered phone numbers).

Individual clients have no product-type restrictions and may purchase glasses, contact lenses, consumables, and in-store services.

    • getPricingStrategy

      public double getPricingStrategy()
      Returns the pricing strategy multiplier for this client. A standard client pays the full price (multiplier = 1.0). Each additional registered phone number grants a 5% loyalty discount, with a maximum 20% discount (multiplier ≥ 0.80).
      Specified by:
      getPricingStrategy in interface Customer
      Returns:
      a price multiplier between 0.80 and 1.0 (inclusive)
